overrides.note: Lian Li O11 Dynamic EVO RGB (455.7 mm GPU, 167 mm cooler per Lian Li's own page). Since Q6 normalize_case keeps RGB in this name (one model for 'O11 Dynamic Evo RGB' and 'O11D EVO RGB'), but makers/__init__.apply matches by prefix, so the plain EVO page (o11-dynamic-evo, 426 mm) still matches O11DYNAMICEVORGB until the o11d-evo-rgb page is in public/data/makers/lianli.json (lianli.norm reads O11D as O11 Dynamic since Q6, so the next scrape ranks and fetches it). Remove this entry once that page is cached with gpuMaxMm 455.7.

NZXT H9 Flow (2025, CM-H92F…): GPU clearance up to 459 mm on NZXT's H9 Flow, H9 Flow RGB and H9 Flow RGB+ pages (410 mm only with a 56 mm thick 420 mm AIO at the front-right). The shops' 200 mm is the PSU length, so the builder hid every long card (test drive finding 9). Every shop page checked under this key names a CM-H92F part number (none the 2023 CM-H91F), and NZXT no longer lists the 2023 case. Remove once the shops/makers give this key gpuMaxMm 459.
